canonical_title: Turbojet and turbofan engine thrust reverser systems tests.

versions.title_at_revision: Turbojet and turbofan engine thrust reverser systems tests.
versions.text: [Thrust reverser systems of turbojet or turbofan engines must meet the requirements of Sec. 33.97 of this chapter or it must be demonstrated by tests that engine operation and vibratory levels are not affected.]
